description.zh: 转接呼叫的目标电话号码。
description.en: The target phone number for call transfer.

description.zh:
转接呼叫的主叫电话。非必填。


<notice>
默认CallerNumber为启动电话后，智能体的电话号码:1. 呼入线路，智能体号码为坐席号码。2. 呼出线路，智能体号码为主叫号码。</notice>
<warning>阿里云线路不支持传入此参数。</warning>
description.en:
The caller phone number for the transferred call. Optional.

><notice>

By default, the CallerNumber is the agent's phone number after the call starts:
1\. For inbound lines, the agent number is the agent’s seat number.
2\. For outbound lines, the agent number is the original caller number.


></notice>

><warning>

Alibaba Cloud lines do not support this parameter.

></warning>

description.zh: 转接失败时播放的异常提示文本。默认空。
description.en: Abnormal prompt text played when the transfer fails. Default is empty.

description.zh: 当前通话实例ID,仅在呼入转接场景中使用。
description.en: Current call instance ID, used only in inbound call transfer scenarios.

description.zh: 转接开始前播放的提示语文本，为空则跳过提示直接播放铃声。默认空。
description.en: Prompt message played before initiating the transfer. If empty, the system skips the prompt and plays the ringing tone directly. Default is empty.
